_description: Pre-defined answers for common screening questions on job applications. Claude uses these for consistency when filling forms.

work_authorization.visa_status: Authorized to work in the United States

job_preferences.desired_salary: Negotiable based on total compensation and role scope
job_preferences.remote_preference: Open to remote, hybrid, or on-site

diversity._note: These are optional EEO questions. Answer only if the form requires it.

common_questions.why_interested: I'm drawn to this role because it aligns with my experience.
common_questions.greatest_strength: My ability to bridge AI engineering and machine learning.
common_questions.greatest_weakness: I sometimes spend extra time optimizing systems beyond what's immediately needed..
common_questions.where_see_yourself_5_years: Leading AI engineering or ML engineering initiatives at a company.
common_questions.describe_challenge: I designed a AI pipeline with schema reconciliation.
common_questions.tell_me_about_yourself: I'm an AI Engineer with a Bachelor's in AI Engineering from the University of Artificial Intelligence. I have 2+ years of experience building production AI systems & ML pipelines, and cloud infrastructure.
common_questions.leadership_example: At John Doe Inc., I led a AI team through structured agents reviews and deploying sessions.

_matching_rules.description: When Claude encounters a screening question not listed here, it should: 1) Try to answer from master_resume.json data, 2) For subjective questions, craft a professional response highlighting relevant experience, 3) For unknown factual questions (e.g., specific salary number), leave blank or select 'Prefer not to say'.
